name: Ash-bitten Bones
counterplay: Hold Frontline and clear them before they overwhelm the companion lane.

name: Vowless Pilgrim Shade
counterplay: Shield Oath it early so it marks the Bulwark instead of a fragile target.

name: Bell-Ringer Shade
counterplay: Use the wax channel or pressure the shade before the ritual completes.

name: Bone-Hook Crawler
counterplay: Hold Frontline so Midline and Backline targets do not get dragged through hazards.

name: Bone Rattle Add
counterplay: Swap damage before add pressure overlaps with Vowless Mark.

name: The Bellgrave Warden
counterplay: Face the boss Frontline, save Guard Stance for heavy telegraphs, use the Road-Seal Bell before Final Toll.
